أستجنن (form X)
# أَسْتَجْنِنْ (ʔastajnin) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.nin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
# أُسْتَجْنَنْ (ʔustajnan) /ʔus.tad͡ʒ.nan/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
